'''''Starcourse''''' was an electronic game available to visitors of [[Astroport Interstellar Services]], a section of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] [[Tomorrowland Starport|spaceport]]. The game allowed multiple individuals at once to pilot simulated spacecraft displayed on a large monitor while operating controls on moving platforms.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Paris only}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Starcourse'' was also a real game at the Astroport Interstellar Services' arcade area, located after the exit of the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] ride at [[Disneyland Paris]] from [[1993]] to [[2005]].<ref name="Lost Treasures">{{WebCite|url=https://www.designingdisney.com/content/lost-treasures-discoveryland|text=Lost Treasures - Discoveryland|work=Designing Disney|archivedate=20220303153751}}</ref>
